The Commission staff report on the LG&E/KU 2024 integrated resource plan loaded and was read. It names retirements at Mill Creek and Brown but none of the Trimble County combustion turbines. I did not read the full plan volumes or the Title V permit documents, which the permit harvest lists as not online.
Title V permit V-22-028, final January 20, 2023, 103 pages, read as text. It lists the six turbines, with no retirement date, and the emergency engines as separate units.
The executive summary of the same permit says the plant has six natural gas-fired combustion turbines plus seven diesel emergency generator engines and a diesel fire pump engine.
This is the East Kentucky Power Cooperative 2022 resource plan order. The plant name appears only in testimony about other utilities, and the case does not concern the Trimble County turbines.
